prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A chubby, egg-shaped, bright lemon-yellow cartoon cat laughing hysterically. Its absurdly huge, wide-open mouth fills most of its face, and two tiny black dot eyes sit at the very top of its head. It is drawn as a simple 2D children's-cartoon mascot reaction sticker on a plain white background.

Body: one smooth, squat blob with no neck. The head and body merge into a single rounded shape that is wider at the bottom, with tiny stubby arms, two short nub feet and a short stubby tail. The fur is flat yellow like a baby chick, with no stripes, patterns or fur texture, and there is a pale cream oval patch on the belly. The cat features are minimal: two small rounded triangle ears on top, pink inside; three thin whiskers on each cheek; and a tiny pink nose just above the mouth.

Face: the mouth gapes in a giant "HAHAHA" belly laugh. It is a huge half-moon opening with a gently curved top edge and a deep round bottom, stretching almost the full width of the head. Inside it is dark red with a pink tongue and no teeth. The small shiny dot eyes sit far apart above that enormous mouth, giving the cat a dopey, almost frog-like look. Soft pink blush ovals sit on the cheeks. The head is tipped back slightly, the round belly is pushed forward, and the little paws rest on its tummy. A few short shake lines at its sides show it trembling with laughter.

Style: clean dark outlines, flat saturated colors with only soft, simple shading, smooth and rounded, adorable but dumb and slightly unhinged. Full body, front view, centered, square image, no text, not a realistic cat.
